20261122-chemistry-g10-1.material: [Advanced structure of matter] Among di molecules wey period 2 nonmetal elements dey form, which one correctly match di number of shared electron pairs and lone electron pairs of methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃) and water (H₂O), wey satisfy di octet rule (8 electrons for di outermost shell)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced structure of matter] Among di molecules wey period 2 nonmetal elements dey form, which one correctly match di number of shared electron pairs and lone electron pairs of methane (CH₄), ammonia (NH₃) and water (H₂O), wey satisfy di octet rule (8 electrons for di outermost shell)?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.explain: Methane ($\text{CH}_4$) get $4$ shared and $0$ lone pairs. Ammonia ($\text{NH}_3$), because of di nature of nitrogen, get $3$ shared and $1$ lone pair, and water ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$) get $2$ shared and $2$ lone pairs.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.0: Carbon (C) get 4 valence electrons and e form covalent bond with all 4 hydrogens.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.1: Nitrogen (N) share 3 out of 5, and di remaining 2 na 1 lone pair. Oxygen (O) share 2 out of 6, and di remaining 4 na 2 lone pairs.

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.material: Wetin be di environmental problem wey sulfur dioxide (SO₂) or nitrogen oxides (NOx) wey dey comot from burning fossil fuels dey react with water vapour for di atmosphere to form sulfuric acid or nitric acid and lower di pH of rainwater below di normal (about 5.6)?

20261122-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.explain: Sulfur oxides and nitrogen oxides dey react with water for di atmosphere to form strong acids, sulfuric acid ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$) and nitric acid ($\text{HNO}_3$), and dis dey cause strong acid rain wey get $\text{pH} < 5.6$ wey dey make soil and lakes acidic.
